DiscountCodeError builds the common ones: expired with the date, the amount still needed to reach a minimum, codes that can’t be combined, and codes that don’t exist. The block catches codes that are already applied and the code limit without calling you.

Totals are a description list, so each amount is read with its label. Discounts read “Discount WELCOME10, minus $36.80”, and each line reads its quantity.

Totals come in the order shoppers expect: subtotal, one line per discount with its code as a chip, shipping, taxes and the total with its currency code, “USD $339.78”. Shipping reads “Calculated at next step” until you know it, shows a skeleton while it is being worked out and reads Free when it costs nothing. Taxes are labelled Estimated until you mark them final, with an optional basis such as “Estimated for 94110”. Store sales, discounts and free shipping add up to a “You saved” line.
